title: Chapter 143
text:
Stunning the enemy was the specialty of mental attacks. Their mental resistance was also very high. However, the Explosive Grenade would cause the stun on a physiological level and cause the ear water to vibrate. Therefore, it did not depend on one's mental resistance but on one's endurance. It was the nemesis of those who specialized in mental attacks.

Hella was immediately hit. Her cold and elegant face was now filled with pain. She was tossing and turning like waves.

No matter what Hella's background was, she only had one identity in battle, and that was the enemy! Han Xiao never knew how to spell the word "softheartedness". He sprayed the two guns furiously, and the bullets were slanted on Hella's body, emptying the magazine. Then, before Hella could endure the pain and counterattack, he kicked her abdomen with the high-speed inertia with his electromagnetic hover-boots, sending her flying into the air. She crashed through the railing and fell into the river.

The surface of the river was dyed red with blood, and Hella's body sank into the river. Han Xiao naturally did not believe that Hella would die, and there was no notification on the interface. He estimated that after this series of attacks, Hella would be able to recover in a short while, so there was no need to worry for the time being.

"This kind of troublesome enemy can't be killed. We can't fight them head-on."

As this thought flashed through his mind, Han Xiao finally had the time to look at Li Ya Lin and the others. His former teammates were looking at him in surprise.

"Black Phantom?" Zhang Wei asked tentatively. For some reason, he found the name familiar.

It seemed that she did not recognize him. That was good. Considering the hatred the Germinal Organization had for Zero, it was safer to continue hiding. Han Xiao's eyes flashed, but Li Ya Lin suddenly screamed.

"Han Xiao?!"

Han Xiao was puzzled. "Han Xiao? Who was that? You've got the wrong person. "

"It's you! You're still pretending! I'll recognize you even if you turn into ashes! "Li Ya Lin gnashed her teeth.

Damn, how did you recognize it? How could I not fool him with my superb acting skills!

Han Xiao was very surprised.

You little girl, you don't play by the rules!

The other members of the team were stunned. They were 30% suspicious of Li Ya Lin's judgement, but 70% believing it. They sized up Han Xiao from head to toe. At this moment, he was dressed in black and had dual pistols in his hands. He looked elegant and drenched in blood. More importantly, he had revealed his face!

"So that's what you look like …" Zhang Wei murmured. He finally understood why Han Xiao used to wear a mask.

When he was serving in Stardragon's Scapegoat Bureau, Han Xiao was always wearing a mask. The team members didn't know Han Xiao's true face, and they didn't know Han Xiao's true identity. They immediately thought that the face under the Facial Simulator was Han Xiao's true face. They originally thought that he would be very handsome …

Who would have thought that the famous Black Phantom was actually a former teammate? Everyone's feelings were very complicated. They were very shocked and full of doubts. Was he really that strong in the past? Why didn't he reveal it? Why did he leave Stardragon and become an assassin? Why did the higher-ups even allow it?

Wait, he had become the Black Phantom of the Dark Net, and the attitude of the higher-ups was ambiguous. Could it be … that this was actually a secret mission?

"You're mistaken. There's no time for nonsense. The enemy is here! Han Xiao said righteously.

Li Yalin's eyes were spitting fire. "It's useless even if you deny it!"

That's right! He must be following the orders of the higher-ups to carry out a secret mission. That's why he can't reveal his identity! Could it be that Stardragon is going to attack the Dark Net?

Everyone was shocked. A misunderstanding had unknowingly formed.

The conversation happened very quickly. They were on the battlefield, so they could only suppress the doubts in their hearts and focus on dealing with the enemy. The battle between Stardragon's assault force and the Germinal Organization's soldiers was very fierce. Supers were everywhere using their powers. The screams and gunfire played a symphony together.

A Germinal Organization executive officer rushed toward Han Xiao and the others. Han Xiao pointed his pistol at him. His meaning was obvious. Zhang Wei and the others naturally had no objections and fought side by side.

While the Germinal Organization executive officer was running, his body expanded like a balloon and turned into a four-meter-tall white beast. He looked like a wolf, running on the deck, and his weight made the deck tremble. He opened his bloody mouth and bit toward them. His movements were full of strength and beauty.

Shapeshifting Esper Abilities were a common branch. There were all kinds of strange forms that crossed the boundaries of races. Some were strong and some were weak. It was said that it was related to genetic atavism and genetic mutation. Some shapeshifters would become mutated creatures, but they could also become wild beasts. This kind of Esper Ability was most common on planets with a magical background. Some shapeshifters could even pass down their Esper Ability through reproduction, forming a bloodline, or they could awaken this kind of Esper Ability through training.

Science and magic were different civilizations. There were differences in the cognition of certain things. The methods of research were also different, and the stages of development had their own characteristics.

The white wolf jumped on the deck and bit. Han Xiao, Zhang Wei, and the others worked together to fight this executive officer. This time, he played the role of a bystander and let Zhang Wei be the main tank while he shot from the side. Occasionally, he would close in and cut off a piece of flesh with the thermoelectric incisor gloves.

Hou Yue also used two guns, and his movements were smooth. He was originally proud of this, but when he saw Han Xiao's clean, simple, and unflashy double gun technique, he suddenly felt like he was a juggler and lacked a murderous aura.

No wonder he is the famous Black Phantom of the underground world. He is so good with two guns. Hou Yue was impressed. Originally, joining Zhang Wei's team was an order from the higher-ups. He had never heard of Zhang Wei's team having any particularly good battle results. He did not expect that the monstrous Black Phantom was actually a member of this team.

The white wolf was beaten black and blue. When it realized that it was not strong enough and that the other executive officers were too busy to help, it turned around and tried to escape. Han Xiao was already prepared. He aimed his guns at the eyes of the white wolf and fired, activating the [Flaming Will] that had finished its cooldown.

This time, he was lucky enough to get 3.2 times the damage!

"Bang!"

The white wolf's eyes exploded, and it groaned in pain. It fell on the deck, and the whole barge shook. Zhang Wei immediately followed up with another attack. He had already used up all his ammunition, and an alloy blade grew out of his arm armor. The K600 endoskeleton powered him, and he jumped up and slammed into the white wolf's body. The alloy blade crazily stabbed many wounds.

The others did not stay idle either. They swarmed up and killed the white wolf.

At this time, the fleet finally reached the estuary. The assault boats that were supporting the assault team appeared on the river and signaled for retreat. Zhang Wei turned to Han Xiao and asked, "Han … Black Phantom, do you want to retreat with us?"

"No need." Han Xiao waved his hand.

"Okay, thank you for your help. I will remember, and so will Stardragon!"

Zhang Wei's tone was meaningful. He turned around and jumped onto the assault boats with his team members. Li Yalin looked at Han Xiao deeply.

While the people of Division 13 were retreating, Han Xiao activated his electromagnetic hover-boots and jumped back to the shore. He rushed to the truck that had been following them automatically. He jumped into the driver's seat and switched to manual driving. He immediately escaped from the riverbank.

Hella, who was drenched, climbed onto the boat. Her head was still dizzy, and she stared in the direction of the truck. She had always been the one to deal with others like this, but this time, she was the one who got her revenge.

"Black Phantom, I will remember you!" Hella's eyes were cold, and the wounds on her body healed quickly.

The Germinal fleet reached the estuary. They fired torpedoes and detonated the mine formation in advance. The explosion created huge waves and successfully entered the sea.

Hesla's naval forces also recovered and chased after them. The submarines of both sides restrained each other, and the Germinal fleet went deep into the sea.

From a strategic point of view, the Germinal Organization broke through the blockade and successfully escaped.

However, from a battle perspective, the Germinal Organization lost at least seventy percent of its troops, while Stardragon and Hesla's losses were less than one-tenth of the Germinal Organization's. It could not be considered a victory for the Germinal Organization.

Although they did not manage to intercept all of the Germinal Organization's troops, the two countries had achieved the strategic goal of "attacking the enemy to a greater extent."

Overall, the winner of this battle was still Stardragon and Hesla.

…

Through the window, Han Xiao looked at the sea. The flames of the naval battle were fading away in his vision. He shook his head.

"The battle is over."

Han Xiao looked at Mad Blade, who had revived and was sitting in the passenger seat. He wrote a generous mission without any requirements. Mad Blade had blocked the attack for him. Although he did not need it, he would not be stingy with the experience points.

The introduction of the mission was a reward for blocking the attack. Mad Blade was very surprised. He did it completely subconsciously. It did not matter if he died, but he could not let anything happen to Han Xiao. He did not expect to receive such a pleasant surprise, and this made him even more determined to rely on Han Xiao.

[Second Advancement], Progress 3/3

The Executive Officer Giant Wolf that he had killed with Zhang Wei and the others was a LV 45 character. Because it was a team kill, the additional experience points were not much, but it was considered to have completed the cross-level kill requirement. This also meant that …
